VFM_05_Launch.inherited: From Vectors_Act2_VectorArithmetic: Before these operations spread into fields, the next room uses them to separate a launch velocity into components and compare the resulting arcs.
VFM_05_Launch.question: Does aiming higher always send a launch farther?
VFM_05_Launch.ontology: A launch velocity has horizontal and vertical components. Gravity changes the vertical component over time, so the initial direction and the resulting curved path are different things.
VFM_05_Launch.experiment: Move the ANGLE slider and compare the traced arc, its apex and landing marker. Find a low and a high angle with similar range while the launch power stays fixed.
VFM_05_Launch.observe: A steeper direction increases the upward share but reduces the horizontal share. Range grows and then shrinks; complementary directions can land at the same horizontal distance by different paths.
VFM_05_Launch.limit: The range relationship assumes fixed gravity, no air resistance and landing at launch height. The displayed trace does not demonstrate collision, wind or steering during flight.
VFM_05_Launch.variation: Choose a high route and a low route to the same landing and compare which would clear an imagined obstacle. An actual obstacle test would require a separate launch simulation.
VFM_05_Launch.handoff: In the next room, motion continues to accumulate under forces that can change its course or prevent it from beginning. Keep the distinction between the initial condition and what acts afterwards.
open_questions: Do not follow the identity header’s claim that this specific toy throws the visitor. Power is a configuration value; only ANGLE is a visitor slider.

VFM_03_Motion.inherited: From VFM_05_Launch: In the next room, motion continues to accumulate under forces that can change its course or prevent it from beginning. Keep the distinction between the initial condition and what acts afterwards.
VFM_03_Motion.question: How can a continuous adjustment produce a sudden start?
VFM_03_Motion.ontology: A force balance can hold a body still until a threshold is crossed. The component of gravity along a slope competes with a friction bound set by the normal component.
VFM_03_Motion.experiment: Keep the ramp angle fixed and move μ until the block changes between STATIC and SLIDING. Then hold μ fixed and vary ANGLE. Use RESET to compare fresh runs.
VFM_03_Motion.observe: The labels and force arrows change as the block begins to move. Below the threshold the model holds the block; above it the displayed velocity accumulates and the block accelerates down the ramp.
VFM_03_Motion.limit: The model uses one coefficient and a simplified state switch, whereas real contacts may distinguish static and kinetic friction and have more complex material behavior. No movement is not evidence of no forces.
VFM_03_Motion.variation: Approach the threshold from each side and compare the displayed decision. A separate static/kinetic coefficient pair would be a proposed extension capable of demonstrating hysteresis.
VFM_03_Motion.handoff: Vectors, fields and motion follow. Carry forward this habit: identify what is changing, what is accumulating, and which influences the model includes.

VFM_08_Arena.inherited: From VFM_09_Legs: One teleport on, in the Arena, a small black crab on four long jointed legs is walking the only true plant-and-step gait in this museum, at a tenth of this size, and it is looking for you.
VFM_08_Arena.question: If two collisions conserve the same kind of quantity, must their outcomes look alike?
VFM_08_Arena.ontology: Momentum combines mass with signed velocity. Conservation constrains the sum, while the distribution of velocity between bodies can change.
VFM_08_Arena.experiment: Move MASS RATIO on the collision-carts console. Compare the upper before lane with the lower after lane: track the striker’s arrow as it reverses, disappears near equal masses, and points forward for a heavier striker.
VFM_08_Arena.observe: Changing the mass ratio changes both outgoing arrows. A light striker rebounds, equal masses transfer the incoming motion in this model, and a heavy striker continues forward while the other cart leaves faster.
VFM_08_Arena.limit: This is an ideal elastic, isolated, one-dimensional comparison, not a live collision arena. Arrow lengths include a visual minimum, so their lengths are not an exact ruler for measuring momentum.
VFM_08_Arena.variation: Predict the sign of the striker’s outgoing velocity before moving through equal masses. A sticky collision would conserve momentum with a different energy result, but no restitution control is available on this console.
VFM_08_Arena.handoff: The next room considers force as a place. Bring the habit of looking at the whole relationship before judging an outcome from one body's motion.
